hooks.command: [ -z "$NUDGEWHEN_IDLE_DIR" ] || { umask 077; t="$NUDGEWHEN_IDLE_DIR/.nudgewhen-idle.$$"; cat > "$t" && id=$(sed -n 's/^.*"session_id" *: *"\([A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\)".*$/\1/p' "$t" | head -n 1) && [ -n "$id" ] && mv "$t" "$NUDGEWHEN_IDLE_DIR/nudgewhen-idle-$id.json" || rm -f "$t"; }; exit 0
